text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: estimate of AC capacity in MW. Line: range from resampling whole months, divided by the recoveries measured on known farms and plants at other Primaries, so a spread over test scenarios and not a calibrated 80% interval. Grey dashed line: experiment 45's pinned capacity, a control and not a truth.'
